subject: Audit log exporter evidence package review (customer-ready bundle)
body:
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com>
To: Dr. Aisha Rahman <aisha.rahman@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, Feb 20, 2025 at 9:12 AM PT
Subject: Audit log exporter evidence package review (customer-ready bundle)

Aisha,

We pulled together the customer-ready “evidence package” bundle for audit logs + retention config export (baseline for the Compliance Reporting Pack MVP).

Ask: can you do a quick Security sign-off on the format + language so we can share externally (Northbridge security review is blocked on this)?

What’s included (v0.3):
- PDF overview: what’s in scope, export fields, how to validate completeness
- CSV template: audit log export report fields (per template)
- JSON sample: retention config export (schema v1.1)

Open questions we’d like you to weigh in on:
1) “Immutable” wording: can we say “tamper-evident” vs “immutable” (given some storage backends differ by tier)?
2) Checksums/signature: do we need to require it for external evidence, or “available on request” for v1?
3) Any red flags in the section describing event types/coverage?

Attachments:
- Redwood_Evidence_Package_Audit_Logs_v0.3.pdf
- audit-log-export-template_v1.csv
- retention-config-export_sample_v1.1.json

Thank you,
Naomi
Naomi Feldman
Dir PM, Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference

---

From: Dr. Aisha Rahman <aisha.rahman@redwoodinference.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, Feb 20, 2025 at 10:01 AM PT
Subject: Re: Audit log exporter evidence package review (customer-ready bundle)

Naomi,

Reviewed. Overall direction is good, but I’m not comfortable with this going to customers as-is.

Required changes before external share:

1) Language: do NOT claim “immutable.” Use “append-only and tamper-evident controls” (and make clear by tier). We should explicitly say that customers can export and independently store evidence.

2) Add a short “Evidence integrity” section:
- include export generation timestamp (UTC)
- include the query parameters (time window, filters)
- include exporter version + template version
- include a checksum for the delivered bundle (even if it’s just SHA-256 in a manifest file)

3) Field definitions: the PDF references “actor” and “principal” interchangeably. Pick one term and define it (human user vs service account vs API key).

4) Coverage caveat: we need a clear statement on what’s in scope for audit logs in v1 and what is not (e.g., data plane request/response logs are separate; traces/metrics are separate). Customers will assume “audit logs” covers everything.

5) Data residency: add a one-liner that exports are generated from the tenant’s configured region and that the bundle is delivered via customer-approved channel.

6) Legal hold: add a sentence that legal hold overrides configured retention deletion where applicable (we can keep it high-level; no process details).

Nice-to-have (not blocking if timeline is tight):
- Add a “common validation steps” section (count by event_type; compare to admin actions performed in period).

Lauren: once these edits are in, I’m fine with us sharing externally.

Aisha
Dr. Aisha Rahman
CISO
Redwood Inference

---

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com>
To: Dr. Aisha Rahman <aisha.rahman@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, Feb 20, 2025 at 11:08 AM PT
Subject: Re: Audit log exporter evidence package review (customer-ready bundle)

Thanks — super clear.

We can do items 1–6 today. Plan:
- Update PDF language + definitions
- Add manifest file (bundle_manifest.json) with:
  - generated_at_utc
  - exporter_version
  - template_version
  - window_start/window_end
  - filters
  - sha256 list for each artifact

Quick confirm on #2: if we include a SHA-256 manifest, do we also need a signature in v1 (PGP) or can we leave signature as “available upon request / roadmap”? My assumption: manifest is enough for evidence integrity for now.

Also for #6 (legal hold): we’ll add a high-level statement, but not include workflow/approver names.

Will share v0.4 back for your final OK.

Naomi

---

From: Dr. Aisha Rahman <aisha.rahman@redwoodinference.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, Feb 20, 2025 at 11:22 AM PT
Subject: Re: Audit log exporter evidence package review (customer-ready bundle)

Manifest with SHA-256 is sufficient for v1.

Do NOT mention PGP/signature unless we can consistently deliver it; instead say:
“Redwood can provide additional integrity attestations upon request.”

Also: please add one explicit sentence:
“Audit logs record control-plane security-relevant actions; they do not contain model inputs/outputs.”

Aisha

---

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Dr. Aisha Rahman <aisha.rahman@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, Feb 20, 2025 at 1:47 PM PT
Subject: Re: Audit log exporter evidence package review (customer-ready bundle)

Thank you both.

Northbridge is asking for “a sample evidence package” and “the list of included audit event types” by EOD Mon (2/24) to keep their SOC2/ISO review on track.

Naomi — when do you expect we can send v0.4 to me for external forwarding?

(Tracking under SUP-3842; they’re also asking about retention defaults by tier but I can handle that separately.)

Lauren
Lauren Bishop
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

---

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Dr. Aisha Rahman <aisha.rahman@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, Feb 20, 2025 at 4:36 PM PT
Subject: Re: Audit log exporter evidence package review (customer-ready bundle)

Lauren — you’ll have it tomorrow morning.

Aisha — incorporating your edits now. We also fixed terminology in the PDF (standardized on “actor” and defined actor_type = {user, service_account, api_key}).

What will be in v0.4:
- Updated PDF with scope statements and the “not model inputs/outputs” sentence
- audit-log-export-template_v1.csv (unchanged)
- retention-config-export_sample_v1.1.json (unchanged)
- bundle_manifest.json (new)

I’ll send the final artifacts for your OK before we share.

Naomi

---

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com>
To: Dr. Aisha Rahman <aisha.rahman@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, Feb 21, 2025 at 9:18 AM PT
Subject: Audit log exporter evidence package v0.4 (final review)

Aisha,

v0.4 is ready for final review/approval to share externally.

Changes made (per your list):
- Removed “immutable”; replaced with “append-only” + “tamper-evident controls (tier-dependent)” and recommendation for customers to export/store independently
- Added Evidence integrity section (timestamp UTC + query params + exporter/template version)
- Added bundle_manifest.json with SHA-256 for each artifact
- Standardized “actor” terminology + definitions
- Added explicit scope statement: audit logs are control-plane security-relevant actions; excludes request/response logs and telemetry
- Added data residency line (generated from tenant configured region; delivered via approved channel)
- Added legal hold statement (high-level)

Attachments:
- Redwood_Evidence_Package_Audit_Logs_v0.4.pdf
- bundle_manifest.json
- audit-log-export-template_v1.csv
- retention-config-export_sample_v1.1.json

If you approve, Lauren will forward to Northbridge.

Naomi

---

From: Dr. Aisha Rahman <aisha.rahman@redwoodinference.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, Feb 21, 2025 at 10:03 AM PT
Subject: Re: Audit log exporter evidence package v0.4 (final review)

Approved for external sharing.

Two small notes (non-blocking for Northbridge; incorporate for the next rev):
- Add “time source” wording (timestamps are generated by Redwood systems in UTC)
- Add a short disclaimer that event taxonomy may expand over time; template_version will reflect changes

Lauren — OK to send v0.4.

Aisha
